description: Feasibility constants, the same values the generator enforces. An assembler pre-computes a legal floor count N for a parcel as: N * minFloorHeight <= parcel maxHeight. With apertures, sort the distinct walkable bases 0 < b1 < ... < bk; each gap g (from 0 to b1, then between consecutive bases) must admit between ceil(g / maxFloorHeight) and floor(g / minFloorHeight) floors, the top base needs at least minFloorHeight of room below maxHeight, and N must fall inside the summed range (E_APERTURE_UNREACHABLE names it exactly). Units meters.
